work.summary: Senior Tech Lead on the Platform team, developing features for an internal development platform serving HPC and research workloads on Kubernetes and OpenStack.
highlights: Design and build platform features enabling researchers to self-service HPC and compute workloads.
Deliver Kubernetes-as-a-Service using Cluster API (CAPO) to provision and manage workload clusters on OpenStack.
Operate and evolve Kubernetes and OpenStack infrastructure underpinning the platform.

work.summary: SRE on the Compute & Virtualization team engineering the IaaS core of a SecNumCloud-compliant sovereign cloud (Thales-Google Cloud partnership).
highlights: Built and operated highly available Kubernetes clusters as the sovereign cloud foundation.
Delivered Kubernetes-as-a-Service with Cluster API (CAPK) to provision and manage workload clusters on KubeVirt.
Delivered a VM-as-a-Service experience with KubeVirt and multi-homed networking via KubeOVN/Multus.
Managed a declarative NixOS environment and built Golang operators with Kubebuilder to automate operations.

technicalEnvironment.Methodologies: SRE, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, DevSecOps

work.position: DevOps Consultant at Orange Business Service
work.summary: Level 3 DevOps Consultant embedded at Orange Business Services as a senior technical authority for cloud-native architecture and DevOps best practices.
highlights: Architected secure AWS infrastructure with Terraform (VPC, EKS, IAM) and operated mission-critical Kubernetes clusters.
Centralized secrets with HashiCorp Vault across Terraform and Kubernetes workloads.
Built a long-term observability stack with Prometheus, Thanos, and Grafana.

work.summary: DevOps engineer in a squad building an internal, self-service Kubernetes-as-a-Service (KaaS) platform for development teams.
highlights: Built the KaaS platform from scratch, automating server and cluster provisioning with Ansible.
Implemented GitOps with ArgoCD and CI/CD pipelines with GitLab CI/CD.
Secured the platform with HashiCorp Vault and Keycloak (OIDC IAM).

projects.name: Chihiro
projects.description: A Go web app that watches Cluster API (CAPI) resources and offers a self-service dashboard to create, edit, and delete workload clusters via a config-driven templating engine, with OIDC auth and group-based RBAC.
highlights: Golang, OIDC auth, real-time UI over WebSockets
Config-driven CAPI cluster templating engine
Group-based RBAC & resource limits

projects.name: RPCU
projects.description: An open source, multi-tenant cloud platform built from scratch on baremetal, running OpenStack as Kubernetes operators (Yaook) on a reproducible NixOS foundation, with CAPI workload clusters and full GitOps via Flux.
highlights: OpenStack control plane as Kubernetes operators (Yaook)
NixOS/Colmena nodes with Cluster API (CAPO) workload clusters
Flux GitOps, Sveltos add-ons, Rook/Ceph & Cilium

projects.name: Netwatch
projects.description: A Kubernetes controller that grants temporary, time-boxed network access via a 'NetworkAccess' CRD, automatically creating and expiring NetworkPolicies to enforce least privilege.
highlights: Golang, Kubernetes controller (Kubebuilder)
Dynamic, time-boxed NetworkPolicy automation via CRD

projects.name: MaxTac
projects.description: A Kubernetes controller that abstracts verbose NetworkPolicies behind simple 'Access' and 'ExternalAccess' CRDs, letting developers define connectivity by application logic instead of low-level selectors.
highlights: Golang, Kubernetes controller (Kubebuilder)
Developer-friendly NetworkPolicy abstraction via CRDs

projects.name: Songbird
projects.description: A CLI tool that lints and simulates Kubernetes network connectivity, evaluating NetworkPolicies to predict whether traffic is allowed or denied before changes reach a live cluster.
highlights: Golang, Kubernetes API integration
NetworkPolicy simulation & pre-deployment validation

projects.name: NixBook
projects.description: A declarative, modular NixOS framework for laptops that defines the entire OS (packages, configs, dotfiles) as code with Nix Flakes for reproducible, shareable environments.
highlights: NixOS & Nix Flakes, declarative OS configuration
Modular profiles with Home-Manager

projects.name: NixOS-Server
projects.description: A server-focused NixOS configuration applying declarative and GitOps principles to bare-metal Kubernetes hosts, where every change is a git push enabling atomic updates and rollbacks.
highlights: NixOS & Nix Flakes, GitOps for bare-metal (FluxCD)
Automated, reproducible Kubernetes host provisioning
